package orgs

// FirstRole is the role of the subject that provisions a tenant.
const FirstRole = "admin"

// TakenError reports a rejected organization slug.
type TakenError string

func (e TakenError) Error() string { return string(e) }

// ErrSlugTaken reports a slug that another organization already owns.
const ErrSlugTaken = TakenError("organization slug is taken")

// ValidSlug reports a well-formed organization slug: 2 to 31 lowercase
// letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
func ValidSlug(slug string) bool {
	if len(slug) < 2 || len(slug) > 31 || slug[0] < 'a' || slug[0] > 'z' {
		return false
	}

	for _, r := range slug {
		letter := r >= 'a' && r <= 'z'
		digit := r >= '0' && r <= '9'

		if !letter && !digit && r != '-' {
			return false
		}
	}

	return true
}

// ValidName reports an acceptable organization name.
func ValidName(name string) bool { return name != "" && len(name) <= 80 }
